requirements.text: Start from https://books.toscrape.com/ and crawl only the first three categories of the side list.
Visit every book each category lists, following the category's "next" pages.
Extract each book's title, price, number in stock and star rating with a language model (no hand-written field selectors), and keep each extracted book (dataset or output).
Ask the model once per page type: later books of the same layout are extracted from what was learned with no model call, and a page that no longer matches what was learned goes back to the model.
Stop all model use once a set spend (e.g. 0.50 USD) is reached, and let the crawl finish without the model (learned extraction still working).
Report which books were left unextracted and why (budget reached, extraction or request failure).
Report the tokens and the cost spent on the model.

api_misuses.assumed: a crawler class with start_category, has_next_page, go_to_next_page and get_books
api_misuses.doc_says: no such module or class exists in the stubs; the crawl is declared with AsyncCrawl, labels, handlers and started with AsyncFoxhound.start_crawl

api_misuses.assumed: methods that crawl a named category, page through it and return books with title, price, stock, rating
api_misuses.doc_says: invented members; nothing in the SDK provides them
